newsitem.title: USA: North American bunkers weak on lack of trade.
newsitem.headline: North American bunkers weak on lack of trade.

text.p: North American bunker prices were mostly lower early this week as lack of demand dampened business and pushed down prices, players said on Thursday.
"There is not much going on," said one East Coast broker. "Suppliers are willing to take a hit just to get something done."
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Houston spot 380 CST was about $3 a tonne on Tuesday to between $92 and $93 a tonne after rising $5 last week.
The market was not affected by continued restrictions on the Houston ship channel due to a weekend barge mishap.
